thread:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a quiet regional DNS tilt from NA -> EU tonight during the 00:00–01:00 UTC window. Goal: gently shift inference traffic for model-v2 to EU edge to validate routing and latency profiles. Will start at 00:10 UTC with 5% canary, then 20%, 50% if green.

Morgan: I can own the rollout and rollback. I’ll be online from 23:45 UTC and will coordinate with oncall. Who's on watch for error budgets / SLOs?

Jamie: I’ll watch the request-error and p50/p95 dashboards, and keep an eye on backend GPU queue length. Link: https://grafana.redwood/team/region-rollouts -> default dashboard.

Sara: Quick prechecks: config push is staged in `infra-routing` repo, branch `na-eu-quiet-tilt`. TTL is currently 60s; plan is to lower to 20s for this window to speed rollbacks. Confirmed with DNS team.

Alex: @Morgan, @Jamie — smoke checklist below (run these from your laptop w/ VPN):
```
# health checks
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://edge-eu.redwood-inference/api/v1/health
curl -sS https://edge-eu.redwood-inference/metrics | grep model_v2\n
# small inference test
curl -s -X POST https://edge-eu.redwood-inference/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"rollout-smoke"}' | jq -r '.id'
```

Morgan: Got it. I’ll run the health checks and post results. If anything >= 500 or missing model shard, we abort and rollback.

InfraOnCall: Note — autoscaler policy has a 2m cool-down; if traffic changes spike, we may see temporary queuing. Keep an eye on `gpu-utilization` panel.

Jamie: Canary plan: 5% (00:10 for 5m) -> evaluate logs + latencies -> 20% (00:20 for 10m) -> 50% (00:40 for 15m) -> 100% (if all clear). Will post status at every step.

Sara: Routing patch (ready to apply via `routerctl`):
```
{
  "policy": "region-tilt",
  "steps": [
    {"percent": 5, "duration_mins": 5},
    {"percent": 20, "duration_mins": 10},
    {"percent": 50, "duration_mins": 15}
  ],
  "fallback": "na-primary"
}
```

Alex: Rollback runbook (if triggered):
- run `routerctl abort --policy region-tilt` to stop the canary and restore `na-primary` route
- i) increase DNS TTL back to 60s (`dnsctl set-ttl edge.redwood 60`) ii) notify customers via status page if >5% errors for >10m

Morgan: I’ll be the one to execute `routerctl` changes. @InfraOnCall please stand by to revert infra-level changes if autoscaler misbehaves.

orchestrator-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window assigned to team: eng-platform. Automated alerting will post at 00:05 UTC.

Jamie: Quick logging tip — grep for `model_v2:route=eu` in logs to isolate canary traffic. I’ll attach a Kibana quick search locally and share if needed.

Sara: All config PRs merged to `main` tag `rollout/na-eu-2026-03-17`. I captured hashes in the runbook.

Alex: Cool. Post status updates in this thread at each milestone (start 00:10, 5% done, 20% done, 50% done, complete). If anyone needs to abort, ping `@here` and call out the reason. :thumbsup:

Morgan: Understood — I’ll ping at 00:10 to start. If dashboards show error rate >1.5% or p95 > 600ms for 3 consecutive mins during a step, we stop and rollback.

Jamie: I’ll post short notes after each step. Planning a final report in #eng-postmortems later today regardless of outcome.

Alex: Thanks all — see you in the thread during the window.
